claims.originating_goal: Reduce HIL live-readiness pull-request fanout from routine receipts, observations, projections, and persisted state while preserving all main-branch runtime observation and automatic validation for source, schema, configuration, tests, and workflow changes.
claims.claim_expires_when: Release only after PR triggers exclude routine receipts/observations/projections/state persistence, source/schema/config/test PR validation remains, all main push observation triggers remain intact, exact-head validation passes, and integration merges.
expected_evidence: pull_request retains schemas, scripts, tests, security/config data, handoffs, inventory, and workflow contract
collision_boundaries: Do not change or suppress main-branch HIL live observation
Do not claim HIL readiness, controlled cycle, private review, publication, custody, release, or activation complete
claims.next_task_after_release: Continue the next collision-free Actions census repair; HIL runtime/readiness remains separately active.
